html:
Operated by Vietlook Travel, the Than Tai Hot Spring Park Full Day Tour is a perfect choice for travelers looking to relax, rejuvenate, and enjoy nature just outside Da Nang City. Nestled in a lush mountain area, Than Tai Hot Spring Park offers natural hot mineral springs, a modern water park, and unique wellness experiences inspired by Japanese onsen culture.

This tour combines comfort, relaxation, and fun, making it suitable for couples, families, and travelers of all ages.

ITINERARY

07:45 – 08:30
Driver and English-speaking tour guide from Vietlook Travel pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang. Depart for Than Tai Hot Spring Park.

08:45
Arrive at the park entrance and check in. Take an electric car to the main swimming pool area.
Enjoy various relaxing activities such as:

  • Jacuzzi pools

  • Luoi River inside Long Tien Cave

  • Mini water park

  • Artificial giant mushroom waterfalls

  • Hydro massage and water jets

Continue relaxing in the natural hot mineral spring lake and experience boiling eggs in natural hot water (at your own expense).

You may also choose optional premium services (not included) such as:

  • Private onsen bath

  • Herbal or mineral baths

  • Local beverages

  • Traditional tea ceremony

12:00
Lunch at a restaurant inside the park.

13:00
Free time to enjoy the water park with many exciting games and activities.

15:30
Drop-off at your hotel.
End of tour services. Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel!

TOUR PRICE: USD 40 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for transfers

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Entrance ticket to Than Tai Hot Spring Park

  • Lunch at the park restaurant

  • Mineral water

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Please provide personal information: Full name, year of birth, gender, nationality, and contact details.

  • Children policy (height-based):

    • Under 1 meter: Free of charge (sharing lunch with parents)

    • 1.0 m – 1.4 m: 50% of adult price

    • Above 1.4 m: Full adult price
